idea-plugin.name: Terminal AI Watcher
idea-plugin.description:
Monitors Android Studio's built-in terminal for AI CLI tool events (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) and sends IDE notifications with system sounds.

macOS: To receive system notification banners, allow notifications for your IDE in System Settings → Notifications. (In-IDE balloon notifications work without this.)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.1

  • New: Codex approval requests now show a "Permission Required" notification, like Claude Code
  • Fix: Windows — Korean and other non-ASCII text in notifications no longer appears as "?"
  • Fix: Codex CLI could fail to start after its settings were updated by both Codex and this plugin; the plugin now edits the Codex config safely and repairs the broken state
